title: [Perf] Optimize maxsim scores computation for pooling models, 13.9% E2E throughput improvement (#35330)

image.wheel_note: first PyPI release after merge (2026-03-07 > 2026-02-26); picked by gen_tasks.py from PyPI upload dates.

workload.note: ColBERT MaxSim over 64 (query 32 x doc 1024..2048, dim 128) CPU fp32 pairs as serving sees pooling outputs; PR's solution imports compute_maxsim_scores (padded GPU bmm batches), baseline tree lacks it so the bench runs serving.py's per-pair compute_maxsim_score loop. Wall-clock ms per 64-pair batch. Author numbers are e2e rerank serving (reported-only).

policy.one_run_is: one `docker run` of the workload cmd per arm per repeat (same image, arm tree swapped in by the prelude)

contention_gate.rules: wait while another tenant uses the GPU (>5 % util or a foreign compute process >1 GiB) or the CPU (load1 > nproc/2)

policy.machine_snapshot: machine.py snapshot per workload run -> data/pr_<n>/work/machine_<arm>_<i>.json

arm_isolation.tree: wipe the wheel's vllm/*.py, copy the arm's vllm/ over site-packages (compiled .so stay)
arm_isolation.files: overlay ONLY task.json:source_files from the arm over the wheel's own tree
arm_isolation.tests_benchmarks: copied from the PR's merge tree to /t without a sibling vllm/ package

policy.noise_model: measure.py: paired log-speedup, MAD sigma, theta = clip(k*sigma, theta_min, theta_max) with k/theta from config.yaml:measure

headline: maxsim_64pairs

reported.gain_evidence: # PR #35330: [Perf] Optimize maxsim scores computation for pooling models, 13.9% E2E throughput improvement
reported.experiments_note: reported = numbers from the PR body (author's machine)

author_hardware_args.text: `vllm bench serve   --model jinaai/jina-colbert-v2   --backend vllm-rerank   --endpoint /v1/rerank   --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256   --dataset-name random-rerank   --num-prompts 2000   --request-rate inf   --max-concurrency 64   --seed 0   -

standalone.run_baseline: docker run --rm --gpus device=0 --shm-size=2g -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 -v $PWD/data/pr_35330:/task:ro -v $PWD/.weights/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface -e ARM=baseline vllm-task:35330 -lc 'A=/base; site=$(python3 -c "import vllm,os;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__)))"); find "$site/vllm" -name "*.py" -delete; cp -a $A/vllm/. "$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.run_pr_solution: docker run --rm --gpus device=0 --shm-size=2g -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 -v $PWD/data/pr_35330:/task:ro -v $PWD/.weights/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface -e ARM=pr_solution vllm-task:35330 -lc 'A=/gold; site=$(python3 -c "import vllm,os;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__)))"); find "$site/vllm" -name "*.py" -delete; cp -a $A/vllm/. "$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.note: The image already holds both trees (/base = baseline commit, /gold = the PR's merge commit); the one-liner swaps the chosen tree over the installed wheel exactly like run_one.sh's prelude, then runs the workload cmd from /t (the merge tree's tests/ + benchmarks/).

test_note: the diff adds test_compute_maxsim_scores_matches_reference_per_pair (imports compute_maxsim_scores): baseline tree fails at import, PR tree passes.
